chat_input: Consulta de prueba con datos N8n
n8n_sql_generated: SELECT t.geographic_location_id, SUM(i.total_amount) as total_sum, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM tax.directive t JOIN account_payable.invoice_detail i ON t.member_id = i.member_id AND t.geographic_location_id = i.geographic_location_id WHERE t.member_id = $1 GROUP BY t.geographic_location_id ORDER BY total_sum DESC LIMIT 50;
n8n_din_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT td.member_id, td.geographic_location_id, aid.total_amount FROM tax.directive td INNER JOIN account_payable.invoice_detail aid ON td.member_id = aid.member_id WHERE td.member_id = $1) SELECT geographic_location_id, SUM(total_amount) AS suma_total, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM base GROUP BY geographic_location_id ORDER BY suma_total DESC LIMIT 50;
